table.name: TLGNS_SAP_BP_PF_SOLDTO
table.description: The soldto partner functions of a given BP-SAREA to another BP-SAREA. The 'Sales Area' information is highly redundant, and must be identical in a) owner b) soldto c) this table.

column.name: SAP_BP_SAREA_ID
column.description: Part of PK, FK tlgns_sap_bp_sarea. The owning BP+Sales Area of the partner function (SAP: defined by KNA1_KUNNR from the BP general data which ownes the partner function).

column.name: SOLDTO_SAP_BP_SAREA_ID
column.description: PART of PK, FK tlgns_sap_bp_sarea. The referred sold-to, including its Sales Area Data. (SAP: defined by KUNN2 + VKORG + VTWEG + SPART, lookup in tlgns_sap_bp_sarea)

column.name: SAREA_ID
column.description: FK TLGNC_SAREA. The Sales Area for which this partner function is defined. This is redundant to the SAREA contained in SAP_BP_SAREA_ID.SAREA_CD and SOLDTO_SAP_BP_SAREA_ID.SAREA_CD; all three SAREA are identical.
